name: load_climate_projection
description: Load a processed climate projection layer for a given climate variable, region, time period, scenario, and optional model. Returns a standardized climate layer artifact with GeoJSON features and metadata.

variable.description: Climate or hazard variable to load. Examples: 'extreme_heat_days', 'tasmax', 'heat_index', 'sea_level_rise', 'precipitation_extreme'.

region_name.description: Region name for the climate layer. Examples: 'Fiji', 'Tonga', 'Melanesia', 'Pacific Island Countries and Territories'.

period.description: Projection period to load. Examples: '2050s', '2060s', '2100s'. A single year like '2050' may be normalized internally to '2050s'.

model.description: Optional climate model name. Example: 'ACCESS-CM2'. If omitted, the first matching registered layer may be used.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

layer_id.description: Unique identifier for the loaded climate layer.

variable.description: The derived climate variable represented by the layer.

source_variable.description: The original source variable used to derive this layer, such as 'tasmax'.

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing the climate layer.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

value_column.description: Main numeric column to use for downstream analysis.

provenance.description: Information about registry lookup, source dataset, source access method, and layer file path.
